architectureDecisions: D1 — BB-155 Work/Attempt/version/Decision + BB-157 own control; immutable evidence blobs, existing apply only. No new phase/database.
D2 — Request/run/observations are EvidenceVersion blob refs, PUBLISH_EVIDENCE CAS/live fence only; suggestion is not Decision/readiness.
D3 — Strict bindingContract exact subjects and authority classes; input evidence versus output evidence avoids self-hash recursion.
D4 — Pinned registry DAG, sequential stable order, publish outcome before next launch; dependency cancellation truthful, full verification mandatory.
D5 — failureContract: product delta, verifier correction, infra <=2 retries, flake <=1 confirmation then hold; JEV transport never multiplied.
D6 — loopContract selective input closure, unknown->all, new trusted unchanged-input attestation only; no cross-Attempt reuse/fresh npm verify.
D7 — Pure action intersects actual nextActions; failed JEV BB-157 LOOKBACK/reflection/material guard; allSAT->merge, exact receipt->delivery.
D8 — Hosted Actions receives immutable canonical bundle; loopback controller alone owns guarded artifact import/publication. No runner service access/secrets or GitHub-derived Work state.
D9 — Delivered BB-155/157 required for Worker; legacy stays unchanged, isolated V2 explicit route. BB-156 owns cutover/no dual-write.
D10 — Seven bounded slices, actual adversarial exports and paired benchmark; Living describes delivered behavior only, research ends READY.
implementationSlices: S1 — scripts/agent-native-ci/contract.mjs implements validateRequest(request,resolved), acceptVerificationObservation(observation,request,resolved), validateRun(run,request,observations), hashBlob(value). Closed bindingContract schemas: exact current subject/verifier/input/hash, full logs, exhaustive disjoint accounting; stale/malformed rejects. N2 invokes acceptVerificationObservation plus positive native EvidenceVersion compatibility test. Own CANONICAL_FEEDBACK_CONTRACT/FAILURE_TAXONOMY.

S2 — Depends S1. scripts/agent-native-ci/planner.mjs implements planVerification(request) and planReverification({request,priorRun,sourceDelta,resolvedInputs}). Stable DAG/check registry, reverse dependency invalidation; unknown reads/environment forces all. No cross-Attempt reuse; required full npm verify always fresh. Return checks/invalidated/reused/reasons without IO. N6 invokes planReverification for stale reuse; additional positive/negative checks cover cycles, undeclared inputs and unchanged attestation. Own SELECTIVE_VERIFICATION/AGENT_CONTROL_LOOP.

S3 — Depends S1/S2. scripts/agent-native-ci/runner.mjs implements executeVerificationRequest({request,checkout,blobStore,onProgress,signal}) and separate publishVerificationRun controller sink. Execute argv sequentially, retain full hashed logs/all retries, classify via failureContract; await sink after each result, cancel/reap dependent work and account every planned check. Hosted sink emits artifacts only; local/controller sink performs existing PUBLISH_EVIDENCE CAS. N5 invokes publishVerificationRun for cancellation/partial accounting; additional tests cover stale append, sink failure, restart and all outcomes. Own CANONICAL_FEEDBACK_CONTRACT/FAILURE_TAXONOMY/AGENT_CONTROL_LOOP.

S4 — Depends S3 and delivered BB-155/157. scripts/agent-native-ci/feedback.mjs implements deriveVerificationAction(snapshot,resolvedRun) and buildJevInput(snapshot,resolvedRun); extend only scripts/blackboard-v2/trust-adapter.mjs loading. Exact complete mandatory deterministic passes may suggest native REQUEST_CANDIDATE_JUDGMENT; actual nextActions/CAS/material guard alone dispatch. Failed independent Decision -> LOOKBACK/reflection; allSAT -> MERGE_PENDING; actual receipt -> DELIVERED. N3/N4 invoke deriveVerificationAction for class-specific bounds/control churn; N7 invokes buildJevInput with actual native guard/context and typed evaluator, proving GitHub status irrelevant. No core lifecycle/store changes. Own AGENT_CONTROL_LOOP/JEV_BOUNDARY.

S5 — Depends S3/S4. scripts/agent-native-ci/github-adapter.mjs implements dispatchVerificationRequest, collectGitHubRun, validateGitHubCallback, projectGitHubStatus. cli.mjs dispatch|collect|project --config ABS --request REF uses adapterContract; edit declared three workflows/jev-ci/package for explicit V2 route, preserve LEGACY. Trusted artifact sink/poll collector owns hosted onProgress; credentials never reach command children. N1 invokes projectGitHubStatus with green/skipped metadata and asserts no readiness. Additional adapter cases cover lost dispatch/duplicates/stale/wrong workflow/missing artifacts and local/hosted semantic equality excluding runtime ids/timing/transport. Own ADAPTER_BOUNDARY.

S6 — Depends S1-S5. test/agent-native-ci-feedback.test.mjs invokes all N1-N7 bound symbols/titles plus every invariant positive/negative. benchmark.mjs runBenchmark: 20 seeded paired samples/scenario, actual runner/planner, raw failures/timings/retries/provider counts per benchmarkContract. All verificationPlan commands mandatory; independent correctness separate. Own BENCHMARK/negative coverage.

S7 — Depends S6. Re-run pinned audit extractor, inspect coverage deltas and retain source/benchmark limits in research brief/audit. Update Living only for actually delivered operations. API mismatch reopens research; exact main/tree/Living receipt gates delivery. BB-156 owns migration. Own CURRENT_STATE_AUDIT/BENCHMARK.

valueHypothesis: Reducing CI from a human-oriented terminal gate to a machine-readable feedback/control plane should shorten agent failure-to-repair latency, eliminate PR/check-state authority leaks, and make autonomous delivery retries/re-verification more correct and cheaper. Research must measure these claims before optimization.

findings: Tekton pipelines.md documents runAfter/results dependencies, retries (not cancellations), when-skips and finally outcome handling; taskruns/pipelineruns document retry attempts and cancellation status. Adopt explicit dependency/run accounting and separate result bytes from execution status.
Reject Tekton retry-on-failure as domain policy: ExHarness needs product/verifier/infra/flake distinctions and exact material progress. Do not add Kubernetes, Tekton dependency or another scheduler.

Current pinned GitHub workflows are primary executable evidence for event snapshots, needs/status, always upload and concurrency. Adapter inputs are exact V2 requests; never rediscover Work from PR metadata.
tradeoffs: Sequential registry DAG initially: reduce first-failure feedback latency by publishing after each check, no unmeasured concurrency optimization. Mandatory full repository verification remains mandatory before JEV/delivery.
Selective re-verification is fast feedback only in initial profile. No optimization can waive a required gate. Unknown dependencies force all checks.
Keep public Core/local verifier API unchanged: wrap current records and separately retain raw classified results. No meaning inferred from success prose or arbitrary summary text.

bindingContract.requestSchema: VERIFICATION_REQUEST_V1={id,hash,subject:{workId,workGeneration,specHash,planHash,attemptRef:{kind,id,hash},candidateVersionRef:{kind,id,hash},candidateSha,candidateTree,inputEvidenceRef:{ref,hash}|null},registryHash,policyHash,requiredGateIds,checks:[{id,verifier:{id,implementationHash,authorityClass:DETERMINISTIC},command,args,inputDigests:[{ref,hash}],dependencies,timeoutMs,maxOutputBytes}],retryPolicy:{infraRetries:2,flakeConfirmations:1},environment:{profile,hash},controllerDigest}. Strict known keys, immutable canonical hash excluding hash field; all refs resolve before scheduling, unique check ids, acyclic deps, required gate ids exactly approved plan. No PR/check fields in semantic subject.
bindingContract.observationSchema: VERIFICATION_OBSERVATION_V1={id,hash,requestRef:{ref,hash},subject:exact request.subject,checkId,verifier:exact registered verifier,executionId,executionState:COMPLETED|CANCELLED|UNAVAILABLE|PARTIAL,outcome:PASS|FAIL|INCONCLUSIVE,failureClass:NONE|PRODUCT|VERIFIER|INFRA|FLAKE_SUSPECTED|INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE|CANCELLED,exitCode:int|null,signal:string|null,evidence:[{ref,hash,bytes,complete:boolean}],inputDigests,attemptOrdinal,reuseOf:{ref,hash}|null,transport:optional metadata}. hash excludes hash; subject/input/verifier binds request, ordinal is canonical run accounting. PASS only completed exit0, verified full required evidence and no subject/tree mutation. Captured truncated preview distinct from full log blob/hash/bytes; missing full required evidence -> INCONCLUSIVE.
bindingContract.runSchema: EXECUTION_RUN_V1={id,hash,requestRef,subject,registryHash,policyHash,executions:[{executionId,checkId,ordinal,startedAt,finishedAt,observationRef}],plannedIds,completedIds,cancelledIds,unavailableIds,partialIds,pendingIds,retryHistory:[{checkId,ordinal,causeRef,class,policyHash}],previousRunRef:null|{ref,hash}}. Sets are disjoint and cover every planned id for latest outcome; executions retain all attempts/conflicts; pending allowed in incremental snapshots, terminal snapshot has pendingIds=[]. No ready/correct/delivered booleans. Timestamps runtime diagnostics only, not material evidence digest.
bindingContract.publication: executeVerificationRequest({request,checkout,blobStore,onProgress,signal})->{run,observations,blobRefs} uses argv processes and no service credential. Await onProgress after each execution. publishVerificationRun({client,snapshot,request,run,observations,blobStore,attemptToken}) is trusted controller/local sink only: resolve full closure, append ordinary EvidenceVersion through existing PUBLISH_EVIDENCE CAS/current gen/Attempt/lease/fence. Concurrent progress: reread same subject, immutable union/revalidate/new CAS; conflicting id/body rejects. Hosted artifact sink cannot mutate native Work; late artifacts retained externally but stale native publication rejects. Run history remains immutable, no new SQL.
bindingContract.authorityClasses: Deterministic observation proves its declared executable check only. SEMANTIC_DECISION_REF_V1={decisionRef,workId,workGeneration,attemptRef,candidateVersionRef,evidenceVersionRef} resolves actual independently validated native Decision, never producer supplied answers. Unified routing envelope refers to either observation or Decision; authorityClass remains distinct. JEV failures route exclusively to BB-157 LOOKBACK; no feedback observation grants reflection acceptance or allSAT.

loopContract.progressiveExecution: Stable topological ordering (id tie-break), concurrency=1, from registered schema/binding/focused/targeted/full verification dependencies. After each check await onProgress({run,observations,blobRefs}) before next launch. Local sink validates and PUBLISH_EVIDENCE CAS; hosted sink uploads immutable progress artifact, with no native service/token. Controller polls/imports hosted progress under native CAS. A product failure cancels its dependents before spawn, independent diagnostics remain accounted. Sink failure stops launch and retains diagnostic blobs. Cancellation reaps process tree; lost runner callback becomes UNAVAILABLE only after canonical timeout. Deterministic registry excludes semantic JEV; JEV is subsequent independent native guarded dispatch.
loopContract.feedbackLoop: deriveVerificationAction(snapshot,resolvedRun) checks exact freshness first; stale -> DISCARD_DIAGNOSTIC, invalid/missing -> ACQUIRE_EVIDENCE, product -> DIAGNOSE_AND_REPAIR with material candidate delta, verifier -> FIX_VERIFIER, infra allowed -> RETRY_CHECK with budget ordinal, flake -> CONFIRM_ONCE/HOLD, partial -> RECONCILE. suggestions must intersect existing nextActions legality, current scope/owner/dependencies and phase; no direct phase setter. Complete fresh mandatory passes -> REQUEST_CANDIDATE_JUDGMENT suggestion only if native guards allow; failure Decision -> READ_FAILURE/DERIVE_REFLECTION/PUBLISH_REFLECTION through BB-157; allSAT -> verify merge then native receipt. Generation/Attempt takeover clears applicability but does not reset retry history/material baseline; new semantic request binds changed inputs. Same request replay is idempotent.
loopContract.selective: planReverification({request,priorRun,sourceDelta,resolvedInputs}) computes changed registered input digests plus reverse dependency closure. Product changed authorized syntax-normalized implementation uses BB-157 trusted material profile; evidence delta uses typed observed projection; prose/control/id/timing churn cannot unlock product/JEV. Unknown/undeclared reads or env/profile change invalidate all. Proven unchanged input checks may get a new trusted REUSE_ATTESTATION observation bound new subject and reuseOf original, validate full original proof and input closure; no raw old PASS accepted. Cross-Attempt reuse disabled in initial profile. Required npm verify is never reused; fresh complete execution required before JEV/delivery.
loopContract.nativeIntegration: EvidenceVersion binds current Attempt/gen/spec/candidate; its body contains request/run/observation refs plus existing implementation evidence projection. Snapshot records resolve hashed blob closure before pure feedback. BB-155 accepts typed evidence payload refs; Worker compatibility test proves this with actual PUBLISH_EVIDENCE without modifying forbidden core. Extend only trust-adapter.mjs evidence loading/projection: require complete passing mandatory checks and exact subject before existing materializeWorkJudgment; preserve question grammar, negative test bindings, main/equal-tree/Living policy. No provider call on missing evidence; only actual REQUEST_CANDIDATE_JUDGMENT from existing nextActions/CAS and BB-157 guard can dispatch.

failureTaxonomy: COMPLETED/exit0 with exact full evidence -> PASS/NONE; no lifecycle advancement.

Trusted assertion adapter identifies executable product-test assertion failure -> FAIL/PRODUCT; raw nonzero unclassified command -> INCONCLUSIVE/VERIFIER, never assumed product defect. No rerun same product subject.

Spawn error, invalid verifier protocol/schema or test harness error -> INCONCLUSIVE/VERIFIER; fix declared verifier/config/environment with changed hash, new request. Existing local SPAWN_ERROR is mapped structurally from reason evidence token, not user prose.

Known runner eviction/network/artifact-upload outage -> INCONCLUSIVE/INFRA, full diagnostics and up to two additional executions on exact same subject; timeout default INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE unless trusted adapter establishes infra cause, never assume flake.

Same pinned subject/check/environment conflicting pass/fail or known nondeterminism -> INCONCLUSIVE/FLAKE_SUSPECTED; retain both, at most one diagnostic confirmation then HOLD even if confirmation passes; trusted policy/verifier correction and new complete evidence required.
Missing logs, unverified digest, incomplete executed coverage or timeout without cause -> INCONCLUSIVE/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; acquire missing proof or repair check, no product correctness inference.
Early dependent cancellation -> CANCELLED/INCONCLUSIVE; lost callback/runner -> UNAVAILABLE or PARTIAL/INCONCLUSIVE; reconcile exact run accounting, never green-on-skip.

adapterContract.githubAdapter: Trusted installed controller CAS-registers pending request+bundle in EvidenceVersion before dispatch. Config={repository,workflowId,trustedWorkflowRef,expectedWorkflowSha,controllerDigest,githubTokenFile:absolute,clientConfig:absolute}; exact request id/hash/candidate/controller are dispatch inputs. Hosted trusted executor checks out pinned controller/candidate separately, never connects to loopback V2. onProgress uploads immutable artifacts named requestId/checkId/ordinal/contentHash; upload credential is isolated in trusted sink, child env allowlist excludes all service/provider/GitHub/runtime tokens. Controller collect polls artifacts during run, validates request/subject/workflow SHA/provenance/full hash closure then PUBLISH_EVIDENCE under current native CAS. Separate judge job uses existing provider credential boundary; only trusted genuine evaluation imports can publish Decision. Lost dispatch response -> lookup request-correlated run-name, never blind redispatch. Exact duplicate artifact id/body idempotent, conflict rejects. Canonical timeout accounts missing callbacks as PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE; GitHub green/skipped/cancelled is not Work authority. Status projection is read-only; API outage blocks transport, never correctness. Local sink instead publishes directly using same contracts. No HTTPS/new server or BB-156 dependency.
adapterContract.legacyCompatibility: LEGACY unchanged; explicit V2 request never discovers/creates Work from PR or writes graph. BB-156 owns selector/migration, no dual-write.
adapterContract.dependencies: Worker pins actual delivered BB-155/157 controller identity, schema and exports. Mismatch returns research. READY plans on baseline are sufficient research design evidence, not runtime delivery.

benchmarkContract.protocol: 20 paired samples/scenario, same seeded fixture/candidate/hardware/runtime/commands: current terminal collector versus progressive adapter. Report all outcomes, p50/p95 first-feedback/total latency, spawned/cancelled checks, retry/provider counts, full evidence bytes. Monotonic timing outside semantic digests; cost unknown=null. Provider timing fixture synthetic; genuine correctness gate separate.
benchmarkContract.gates: Zero false readiness/delivery/stale effects and no identical paid redispatch; first early-error feedback before dependent launch. Successful-run median regression <=10% versus paired baseline; noisy/inconclusive retains baseline scheduling/reopens optimization. Full npm verify mandatory.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: Define one typed, immutable verification observation/evidence contract bound to exact Work generation, Attempt, candidate and verifier subject, including failure classification and freshness.
Define an agent control loop for progressive verification, early failure, diagnosis/repair, material-delta retry, selective re-verification, JEV supervision and convergence to delivery readiness.

Define fail-closed semantics for stale observations, verifier/infra failure, flaky suspicion, partial/cancelled runs and insufficient evidence without converting those states into product correctness claims.
Define the GitHub Actions adapter boundary so required checks/statuses are projections of canonical delivery state rather than inputs that create canonical state.
Produce a bounded implementation decomposition, negative cases, benchmark/evaluation plan and Living Docs impact ready for independent JEV review.
